Context: 5. Monthly subscription and amount of Insurance Cover:-

On the conclusion of the criminal proceedings, the person, if convicted, will be debarred from receiving the share of insurance amounts, which will be paid in equal shares to other eligible persons. If acquitted, his/her share will be paid without any interest. - Para. 11.3.
